items.item: S4 greenhouse run paused on implement-ready
items.next: Cause found Nov 12 (log analyst): the scenario set-up leaves the RC implement switch at 1 (OFF); the MCU starts the mower only at >= 2, so implement_ready never comes. Hidden on 10-23 by a false PERSON stop that the 10-27 narrower LiDAR field removed. Your fix: switch 2 in S3 and S4, applied Nov 12 by the integration engineer. Full rerun done Nov 13 (26.8 h on the clock because the computer slept, about 2 h awake): the implement-ready wait is gone (a 1.8 s blade hold at each start), but testS4 still fails, as it did before the fix: coverage 0.16, no mission_done, XTE RMS 0.068 m and max 0.24 m, because of the two S4 items below. Reviewer Nov 13: keep (S5 and S7 unchanged; the spec row, the bus and the ICD agree). The baseline note for testS4 is updated. Nov 14: the S4 fixes (D66-D69) make the mission complete: see item s4xte for the one criterion left.
